title: C++: Enum Class
description: Use C++11 scoped enums (enum class) for type-safe enumerations.

steps.title: Enum Class Demo
steps.description: Define enum class Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE }. Write a function string colorName(Color c) that returns the name. Call it with Color::RED and Color::BLUE and print the names.
hints: enum class Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE };
Note: scoped, so Color:: prefix is required.

verification.failureMessage: Print Red and Blue from enum class
